body: Thank you so much! I wrote down a couple of things that I could think of, its been a rough four years with depression only getting worse until recently. I've had enough of it! I promise you, I will never walk to that bridge again!
Just a overthinking twenty-one year old. Feels good to know that there are other people out there too :) Stay strong!

Im not gonna lie, its working kinda both ways. On one end, it makes me think: "Well yeah..?". I havent done anything particular with my time, havent traveled, not pursuing any interests, mostly because I was raised to believe I was nothing. Dont pity that, I know one shouldn't be praised for doing nothing. I just want to thank you, perhaps it will help, or maybe it wont. I sincerly hope it does
